hotel_name: JW Marriott Essex House New York

claims.text: The hotel is on Central Park South.

findings.quote: Make our Essex House your home on Central Park South.

claims.text: Central Park and the Central Park Zoo are just across the street from the hotel.

findings.quote: Find two of NYC's most spectacular and celebrated attractions, Central Park and Central Park Zoo, just across the street from JW Marriott Essex House New York.

claims.text: The hotel is an easy walk from Lincoln Center, Carnegie Hall, Columbus Circle and Fifth Avenue.

findings.quote: Facing Central Park and an easy walk from NYC hot spots like Lincoln Center, Carnegie Hall, Columbus Circle and Fifth Avenue

claims.text: The hotel has been classified as a New York Historical Hotel since 1931.

findings.quote: JW Marriott Essex House has been classified as a New York Historical Hotel since 1931.

claims.text: The Essex House rooftop sign was installed in 1932 and has become a fixture of the city skyline.

findings.quote: The iconic "Essex House" rooftop sign was installed in 1932 and has since become a fixture of the city skyline.

claims.text: Rooms include plush bedding, marble bathrooms, minibars, work desks and Wi-Fi.

findings.quote: Our New York hotel rooms near Central Park include plush bedding, marble bathrooms, minibars, work desks, and Wi-Fi.

claims.text: Each suite in the Central Park Suite Collection tells a distinct story through design and artwork inspired by personalities who shaped New York's cultural landscape.

findings.quote: Each fully reimagined suite tells a distinct story through design, artwork, and other touches inspired by personalities who helped shape the cultural landscape of New York City.

claims.text: The Meadow Terrace Suite has terrace views overlooking Central Park's Sheep Meadow.

findings.quote: Gracious terrace views overlooking Central Park's Sheep Meadow provide an inviting space for guests to unwind

claims.text: PRIMP Spa offers massages, facials and body treatments in a Fitness Center treatment room, plus in-room spa services.

findings.quote: PRIMP Spa, our signature wellness destination in Midtown Manhattan. Relax with massages, facials, and body treatments in our Fitness Center treatment room or enjoy the convenience of luxurious in-room spa services.

claims.text: The Central Park running tour is complimentary for hotel guests on Saturdays.

findings.quote: Learn about the history, culture, and architecture of Central Park as the guides from City Running Tours lead Essex House guests
Complimentary for hotel guests on Saturdays at 7:30am.

claims.text: Bourbon Steak New York is Chef Michael Mina's restaurant at the hotel.

findings.quote: Welcome to Bourbon Steak New York by Chef Michael Mina.
Celebrate the details that make meals memorable at Bourbon Steak, located on the lobby level.

claims.text: A JW Marriott partnership with Flamingo Estate greets arriving guests with an herbaceous scent and an immersive soundscape.

findings.quote: JW Marriott has partnered with Flamingo Estate
At JW Marriott Essex House New York, this collaboration comes to life from the moment of arrival, with an herbaceous, uplifting scent and immersive soundscape setting a calming tone.

claims.text: The Promenade Suite is a two-bedroom suite on the 38th floor with panoramic Central Park views.

findings.quote: Located on the 38th floor, this two-bedroom suite features panoramic Central Park views

claims.text: Original ornate brass elevator doors, crystal lamps and chandeliers reflect the glamour of the Art Deco era.

findings.quote: original ornate brass elevator doors, crystal lamps and chandeliers found throughout the hotel all reflect the glamour of the fashionable Art Deco era.

claims.text: The Artisans Terrace Suite has a wraparound terrace and private contrast therapy with a cold plunge and sauna.

findings.quote: Highlights include a wraparound terrace, kitchenette with service entry, and private terrace contrast therapy with cold plunge and sauna.

claims.text: Guides from City Running Tours lead guests on a run through Central Park, covering its history, culture and architecture.

findings.quote: Learn about the history, culture, and architecture of Central Park as the guides from City Running Tours lead Essex House guests and residents through an invigorating run.
